subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Misoprostol, Tranexamic Acid, Bakri Balloon and B-Lynch

steps.tx: The prostaglandin E1 tablet used sublingually or rectally when oxytocin fails or is unavailable is **misoprostol**. Eight hundred micrograms sublingual is the treatment dose. Fever and shivering are common, expected and self limiting. Shivering affects about a third of women at this dose and fever can mimic sepsis for a few hours.
steps.say: Misoprostol eight hundred micrograms sublingual treats haemorrhage when oxytocin fails.

steps.tx: The antifibrinolytic halving death from bleeding when given within three hours is **tranexamic acid**. One gram intravenously is the WOMAN trial dose, with a second gram if bleeding continues. Beyond three hours it no longer helps. The WOMAN trial enrolled over twenty thousand women and showed benefit only when the drug came within three hours.
steps.say: Tranexamic acid within three hours halves bleeding death at one gram intravenously.

steps.tx: The simplest treatment for an atonic uterus is a hand that keeps working. **Uterine massage** rubs the fundus through the abdominal wall to provoke and sustain contraction while drugs are drawn up, and a flabby fundus that fills with clot is emptied and rubbed again. It costs nothing and starts before any medicine arrives. Stopping too early because the uterus firmed once is how massage fails in real emergencies.
steps.say: Uterine massage keeps the fundus contracted while drugs are prepared. A fundus that softens again is emptied and rubbed again.

vis.alt: Image showing uterine massage of the fundus after delivery for postpartum haemorrhage.
vis.caption: A hand is shown massaging the uterine fundus through the abdominal wall after birth. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Firm fundal rubbing stimulating contraction plus expelling clots is **uterine massage**. It is both diagnosis and treatment for atony in the first seconds. Bimanual compression escalates it when external massage fails. Massage is stopped once the uterus stays contracted, because continued rubbing exhausts the muscle again.
steps.say: Uterine massage diagnoses and treats atony in the first seconds of haemorrhage.

steps.tx: An inflatable silicone balloon tamponading the uterine cavity is the **Bakri balloon**. Filled with three to five hundred millilitres, it controls atony while resuscitation catches up. Drainage through its lumen reveals ongoing loss honestly. Three hundred to five hundred millilitres is the fill volume, and the drainage port must stay open to count ongoing loss.
steps.say: The Bakri balloon tamponades the cavity and honestly reveals ongoing loss by drainage.

steps.tx: The brace suture compressing the uterus like a rucksacks straps is the **B-Lynch suture**. Placed at laparotomy, it controls atony while preserving the uterus. Success avoids hysterectomy in most properly selected cases. The suture passes over the fundus like braces, and the uterus is checked by opening it first when a caesarean is already open.
steps.say: The B-Lynch brace suture compresses the uterus and avoids hysterectomy in most cases.

steps.tx: Condom catheter tamponade improvises balloon control where Bakri balloons are unaffordable, termed **condom tamponade**. A condom tied on a catheter and filled works remarkably. It exemplifies frugal innovation saving lives in low resource settings. A condom balloon can be left twelve to twenty four hours and deflated gradually before removal.
steps.say: Condom tamponade improvises balloon control affordably in low resource settings.

steps.tx: Bleeding care climbs a ladder, and skipping rungs wastes the golden hour. The **escalation principle** moves from massage and drugs to balloon tamponade, then surgery or embolisation, declaring each step failed quickly when bleeding continues. Senior help and blood products climb in parallel rather than behind. Teams that announce their current rung aloud coordinate better, because everyone in the room shares the same picture of how serious the bleeding has become.
steps.say: Postpartum bleeding care escalates stepwise from drugs to balloon to surgery, declaring failures quickly. Senior help and blood climb in parallel.

vis.alt: Image showing stepwise escalation of postpartum haemorrhage management.
vis.caption: A stepwise ladder of haemorrhage treatments is shown from massage up to surgery. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Stepping from drugs to balloon to surgery without delay follows the **escalation principle**. Each failed step gets minutes, not half hours, while blood flows. Hysterectomy delayed too long converts a survivable bleed into a death. Senior help is called at 500 millilitres, not after a litre, in most unit escalation charts.
steps.say: Escalation moves from drugs to balloon to surgery in minutes per failed step.

steps.tx: Aortic compression against the spine buys minutes in catastrophic bleeding as a **rescue manoeuvre**. A fist pressed just above the umbilicus slows pelvic flow during transfer or laparotomy preparation. It is a bridge, never a treatment. Pressure is applied with a fist in the midline just above the umbilicus, angled back toward the spine.
steps.say: Aortic compression buys minutes in catastrophic bleeding as a bridge only.

steps.tx: After control, haemoglobin, coagulation and observations continue on a **post haemorrhage protocol**. Thromboprophylaxis timing balances clot against rebleed once stable. Debrief and documentation, including estimated loss method, complete the episode. A haemoglobin check at six hours and again next day catches the woman still bleeding internally.
steps.say: Post haemorrhage protocol continues observations and times thromboprophylaxis once stable.
